## Overlay  (type-only)
interface Overlay {
    readonly root: HTMLElement;
    readonly layers: {
        hud: HTMLElement;
        captions: HTMLElement;
        layout: HTMLElement;
        panels: HTMLElement;
        toasts: HTMLElement;
    };
    readonly stack: PanelStack;
    readonly toasts: Toaster;
    readonly caption: CaptionCard;
    readonly layout: Layout;
    readonly units: Units;
    readonly scale: number;
    readonly rect: Readonly<Rect>;
    readonly frame: Readonly<Rect>;
    setFrame(frame: Rect): void;
    onResize(fn: (frame: Readonly<Rect>) => void): () => void;
    setTheme(theme: ThemeOverrides): void;
    clientToDesign(clientX: number, clientY: number): {
        x: number;
        y: number;
    } | null;
    anchors(camera?: () => AnchorCamera): Anchors;
    updateAnchors(): void;
    reticle(opts?: ReticleOptions): Reticle;
    meter(opts?: MeterOptions): Meter;
    slots(opts: SlotsOptions): Slots;
    heading(opts?: HeadingOptions): Heading;
    grid(opts: GridOptions): Grid;
    card(opts: CardOptions): Card;
    radial(opts: RadialOptions): Radial;
    contextList(items: ContextItem[], opts: ContextListOptions): ContextList;
    readonly drag: DragContext;
    tooltip(target: TooltipTarget, content: string | Node, opts?: TooltipOptions): Tooltip;
    readonly tooltips: Tooltips;
    cursor(opts: CursorOptions): WorldCursor;
    readonly padOwner: PadOwner;
    floats(camera?: () => AnchorCamera, opts?: FloatsOptions): Floats;
    ring(opts?: RingOptions): Ring;
    compass(opts?: CompassOptions): Compass;
    minimap(opts: CanvasMinimapOptions): CanvasMinimap;
    loading(opts?: LoadingOptions): LoadingScreen;
    notify(opts: NotifyOptions): Notification;
    readonly notifications: Notifier;
    destroy(): void;
}

class WorldPanel implements Drawable, WorldWidgetHost {
    readonly transform: Transform;
    readonly width: number;
    readonly height: number;
    readonly resolution: number;
    readonly pxWidth: number;
    readonly pxHeight: number;
    readonly texture: Texture;
    readonly canvas: PanelCanvas;
    readonly painter: Painter;
    readonly theme: PanelTheme;
    readonly stats: WorldPanelStats;
    readonly fontLoaded: Promise<void>;
    readonly drawable: Drawable;
    readonly label: string;
    depthTest: boolean;
    readonly widgets: WorldWidget[];
    focused: WorldWidget | null;
    hovered: WorldWidget | null;
    draws: number;
    constructor(renderer: Renderer, opts: WorldPanelOptions);
    get dirty(): boolean;
    add<W extends WorldWidget>(widget: W): W;
    remove(widget: WorldWidget): void;
    invalidate(widget: WorldWidget): void;
    relayout(): void;
    widgetAt(x: number, y: number): WorldWidget | null;
    repaint(): void;
    update(camera: Camera): void;
    hitTest(ray: Ray): WorldPanelHit | null;
    tester(): HitTester<WorldPanel>;
    pointerMove(x: number, y: number, id?: number): void;
    pointerLeave(id?: number): void;
    pointerDown(x: number, y: number, id?: number): void;
    pointerUp(x: number, y: number, id?: number): void;
    wheel(x: number, y: number, dy: number): boolean;
    poll(pointers: readonly RoutedPointer[]): void;
    attachTo(router: PointerRouter<unknown>): () => void;
    attach(input: WorldPanelInput, opts?: {
        camera?: () => Camera | null;
    }): void;
    detach(): void;
    focus(widget: WorldWidget | null): void;
    focusNext(): WorldWidget | null;
    focusPrev(): WorldWidget | null;
    activate(): void;
    key(event: PanelKeyEvent): boolean;
    prepare(_encoder: GPUCommandEncoder, _frame?: Frame): void;
    draw(pass: GPURenderPassEncoder, frame?: Frame): void;
    dispose(): void;
    get pressing(): boolean;

## WorldWidget

    rect: PanelRect | null;
    readonly layoutRect: PanelRect;

    pressed: boolean;
    focused: boolean;
    host: WorldWidgetHost | null;
    protected theme: PanelTheme | null;
    protected readonly opts: O;
    protected readonly layoutKeys: ReadonlySet<string>;
    protected constructor(opts: O, layoutKeys?: readonly (keyof O & string)[]);
    get options(): Readonly<O>;
    get focusable(): boolean;
    get disabled(): boolean;
    attach(host: WorldWidgetHost): void;
    detach(): void;
    invalidate(): void;
    set(patch: Partial<O>): boolean;
    protected changed(): void;
    abstract measure(width: number): number;
    abstract paint(p: Painter, r: PanelRect): void;
    pointerDown(_x: number, _y: number): void;
    pointerMove(_x: number, _y: number, _down: boolean): void;
    pointerUp(_x: number, _y: number, _inside: boolean): void;
    wheel(_dy: number): boolean;
    activate(): void;
    key(_event: PanelKeyEvent): boolean;
    protected get t(): PanelTheme;
    protected controlHeight(): number;
    protected paintControl(p: Painter, r: PanelRect, fill: string, radius: number): void;
    protected frame(p: Painter, r: PanelRect, radius: number, paint: () => void): void;
}

## WorldWidgetAlign  (type-only)
type WorldWidgetAlign = 'left' | 'center' | 'right';

## WorldWidgetHost  (type-only)
interface WorldWidgetHost {
    readonly painter: Painter;
    invalidate(widget: WorldWidget): void;
    relayout(): void;
}
